offering_description.value: Provides seaborne dry bulk transportation and logistics for industrial commodity shippers. Operates a fleet of owned and chartered ice-class and standard dry bulk vessels, carrying cargoes under long-term contracts of affreightment and spot voyages, and offers related port and terminal logistics.

primary_services.value: dry bulk ocean freight transportation; contracts of affreightment; vessel chartering; cargo logistics and terminal services

customer_segment.value: B2B: steel, mining, agricultural, cement, fertilizer and energy commodity producers and traders

end_markets.value: steel and mining; agriculture; construction materials; fertilizer; energy and forestry products

revenue_model.value: service fees: voyage freight for cargo carried under contracts of affreightment and spot; rental or leasing: time charter hire for vessels chartered to customers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and charters in dry bulk vessels, sold as transport capacity to commodity shippers; service provider: arranges logistics and cargo transport for industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: worldwide routes including Atlantic, Pacific, Baltic and Arctic ice-bound trades

specialization.value: related lines: ice-class dry bulk shipping, contracts of affreightment, chartering and port logistics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with commodity shippers and charterers; agents / brokers: shipbrokers arranging spot charters and cargoes

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: maritime safety and environmental rules from IMO, flag states, classification societies and emissions regulations
